messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Fri 20 Nov
Los40 Music Awards fill Palau Sant Jordi tonight (20:00, reported sold out) — expect Montjuïc and Pl. Espanya to be busy.

TODAY · Fri 20 Nov

1. Hop on The Top - The Last Jam - La Terrrazza 2026
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 23:59 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 549 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €23–580
💬 Hip-hop and funk open-air party, last one of the season on the Poble Espanyol terrace. Early hours, so it works as a tardeo before a club. Listed on four ticket sites; expect several hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2568058

2. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Fri evening · hours vary by bar · 📍 36 bars around Sant Antoni
📊 1,124 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up · 36 bars taking part
💶 €3.80 tapa + drink
💬 A bar crawl you do with friends you already have: hop between Sant Antoni bars, each with a set tapa and drink. No host or stage, not a place to meet strangers. City-guide pick; Friday bars fill up, exact crowd unknown.
https://www.tapantoni.com/es/index.html

3. PRISM pres Kangding Ray & Kerrie
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 INPUT High Fidelity Dance Club
📊 390 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE
💶 €40
💬 Dark, hypnotic techno from Kangding Ray on one of the city's best sound systems. RA's editors picked it and it is also selling on DICE; expect a full room of a few hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2525973

4. La Paloma presents: Quantic Dj set + Chica Acosta + Angela Blackburn
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:30 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 396 interested on RA
💬 Quantic DJs cumbia, soul and funk in La Paloma's old ballroom, a warmer, more danceable night than the techno clubs. Big room and strong interest; expect several hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2571518

5. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Friday Meetup
🕘 Tonight 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 44 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,221 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Weekly founders and startup drinks, the tech crowd in English. A place to meet new people, then head on elsewhere. Mid-sized: likely 40 to 60, going by the sign-ups on two listings.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/317223193/

TOMORROW · Sat 21 Nov

1. [Last 100 tickets] Jackies Open Air Daytime - Closing 2026 Season La Terrrazza
🕘 Sat 19:00 → 03:00 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 700 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €28–580
💬 House season closing on the Poble Espanyol terrace with Octave One, starting early like a tardeo and running to 3am. RA Pick, on four ticket sites and down to the last 100 tickets; expect it packed, so buy ahead.
https://ra.co/events/2534107

2. Monumental Club Indie is Not Dead - Pony Bravo
🕘 Sat 15:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Plaza Monumental de Barcelona
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €16.53
💬 Afternoon-to-night indie party inside the old Monumental bullring: bands, then DJs, bars and food. Go as a group. Featured in @planesenbarcelona's weekend picks (1,124 likes); the ring holds thousands, expect many hundreds.
https://dice.fm/event/mxyo9w-monumental-club-indie-is-not-dead-pony-bravo-21st-nov-plaza-monumental-de-barcelona-barcelona-tickets

3. UNLOCKED pres. MVGRI (ANL)
🕘 Sat 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 BASSHAUS
📊 1,182 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 €10
💬 Cheap late techno night with by far the highest interest of any club listing this weekend, also selling on DICE. Young local crowd; expect a full club of several hundred.
https://ra.co/events/2557201

4. Palo Market Fest
🕘 Sat · hours not stated · 📍 Palo Alto, Poblenou
📊 765 likes on @barcelonasecreta's weekend round-up
💬 Daytime market in a Poblenou garden courtyard: browse clothes stalls, eat and drink, with live music. Somewhere to wander with friends rather than meet people. City-guide pick; hours and entry price not confirmed, check before going.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df7aCWDjMCI/

5. Saturday Connections Night x Piano Club
🕘 Sat 19:00 → 23:30 · 📍 LOCATION AND TICKETS ON LUMA
📊 82 going on Meetup · group has 15,711 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Digital nomads' Saturday social at a piano bar, an international, tech-leaning crowd and an easy place to meet people. Around 80 signed up; tickets and address are on Luma, spots limited.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/317282972/

Scanned: Meetup 429 · RA 80 · DICE 43 · Xceed 24 · Eventbrite 185 · Luma 10 · Instagram 32 posts + 20 stories.
